faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DIPR Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DIPR Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Anaesthesiology (MD), 1 General Surgery (MS), 1 Obstetrics & Gynaecology (MS), 1 Paediatrics (MD), 1 General Medicine (MD).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DIPR Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Technical Wing Office, Chaltlang Lily veng) and send it to Technical Wing Office, Chaltlang Lily veng, Aizawl, Mizoram, by by hand, to reach by 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be ST permanent residents of Mizoram.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit in NEET (PG) 2026 examination conducted by NTA. Cross-checking of application form against official NEET (PG) 2026 results obtained directly from NTA. Based on merit in NEET (PG) 2026 examination.
